I learned the really hard way in the past that you cannot tie your happiness to your time. 

After Vienna and Barcelona I was devastated, which seems ridiculous looking back, if 1/3 marathons go our way we’re doing pretty well. You can do all the training in the world but sometimes the stars just don’t align. 

We are so lucky to be able to go out there and run all around the world and if all we think about is getting faster we lose sight of the beauty that is the marathon. 

The whole city was out to cheer us on, some happy to sit it out, but some not in a place where they could join us, for whatever reason. 

So today I am so grateful that I have the means, physically, emotionally and all the rest. To run.

caption:
THE DREADED TAPER:

At the start of your taper, you fastest marathon time is already determined. The months of hard work are in your legs.

You have two options: maintain your fastest pace by nailing the taper, or slow yourself down by not slowing down.

Option 1: People forget that the work is done - you only gain fitness 2 weeks after a session so there’s no point in any all out efforts. Hard runs, extra steps, bad sleep, bad food = bad taper

Option 2: slow down, relax, eat well, visualise yourself running your best, stretch, hydrate = maintain your fastest speed 

#dublinmarathontaper #dublinmarathon2026 #runcoachdublin
